hook: Anthropic, maker of Claude, files for a US IPO. H1 revenue *$16.3 billion*
tldr: Anthropic filed to list on Nasdaq under the ticker 'ANT' on Oct 26. It reported $16.3 billion revenue for the six months to June 30, 2026, up from $1.16 billion a year earlier. Share count and price aren't set yet.

beats.what: A public registration statement went to the US SEC on Oct 26, after a confidential draft on June 1.
beats.why: The filing shows fast revenue growth and the high cost of building and running advanced AI models.
beats.care: One of the biggest AI listings yet. Indian investors can't buy at IPO directly; it's a signal of how much money is flowing into AI.

cards.caption: H1 revenue growth
cards.body: $1.16 billion → $16.3 billion, six months to June 30.

cards.q: Which ticker has Anthropic applied for?
cards.why: 'ANT' on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.

sources.name: The Hindu
